build_vgg_backbone: build a VGG16 backbone network using make_layers with batch normalization for feature extraction
build_vgg_fpn_backbone: build a VGG16 backbone wrapped in an FPN with LastLevelMaxPool for multi-scale feature pyramids
create_make_layers: create a Sequential convolutional layer stack from a VGG config list with optional batch normalization
review_vgg_backbone_forward: review the vgg_backbone forward pass that returns a dict of features from each stage
refactor_vgg_backbone_stages: refactor the vgg_backbone stage slicing logic that splits the VGG16 modules into 5 stages
